notes.title: Update 1.14
notes.content:
Hello Rattys!

An update is now available for Rat Climber, if you do not see it, please restart your steam client.

[h1]Progress and Wiped Saves[/h1]
I'm very humbly sorry, Rattys. Some players' cheese finding progress and settings have been reset with the launch of Dream World patch 1.13. The progress cannot be recovered in these instances because the save file had been overwritten by technical complications in going from a single world game to multiple worlds, and having to change things to allow the game to be packaged. Please accept my apology and be assured this shall not happen again!! 

Just in case, however, if you want to back up save files, they are located in (drive)>Users>(username)>AppData>Local>RatClimber>Saved>SaveGames and its the file called 1.sav 

[h1]Dream World[/h1]
- Superjump will now be unlocked in Dream World if you have it unlocked in Ratty's World.
- [i]Very[/i] important, secret text added to book on captain's desk!

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
- Graphical options and sensitivity sliders are now saved between play sessions.
- Superjump locked/unlocked UI elements should now display correctly. Superjump should now unlock by checking whether you have the steam achievement for finding all cheeses, instead of [i]just[/i] checking the amount of cheeses you've found.
- Achievement for finishing Dream World levels should now be properly awarded upon reaching the end of Foggy Fortress.
- Trains in Playground level will no longer imprison and softlock you if they stop on top of you. The back of the train is illusionary and now has no collision (it's canonically magical and ethereal!)
- Fixed a floating chandelier in Tempest Tavern that was just levitating midair and living its best life.


[h1]Other[/h1]
- Sound options now include volume sliders for the following categories: master, Sound Effects (mostly ratty running and menu stuff), Ambience (level sounds/portals/trains/ships), and Squeaking
- The game now has a launch banner and taskbar icon showing Rat Climber art.
- Added a fade to black effect when entering portals.
- Sensitivity slider scaling increased by 1.5x to allow for higher sensitivity options. If you remember the old sensitivity number you used, simply multiply it by 1.5x to find the new number that should give you the same feel. For example, I used 0.5 in the old system, so now I should set the sliders to 0.33 to achieve the same feel.

Thank you all so much for the support and sticking with me through a very buggy recent update, but I have been working hard to squash all issues and errors, I shall make this the best ratformer ever made!!

notes.content: [p]This fix will save your record of beating the Dream World levels, even if for some reason the achievement doesn't unlock for you, it will still be recorded and I can try to address it further when possible[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.13 - Dream World
notes.content: [p]Hello Rattys![/p][p]An update is now available for Rat Climber, if you do not see it, please restart your steam client.[/p][p][/p][h1]New world: Dream World[/h1][p][/p][p]There is a new world for you to explore, containing four new zones. You can find the portal to Dream World in the barn behind the spot where you start the game. [/p][p][/p][p]Dream world has its own level timers, and also its own rules. Superjump will be [i]disabled[/i] in this world, so be careful with each step! You will be able to unlock restarting at specific levels just like in the base game, but you need to reach the end of the final zone to unlock this feature.[/p][p][/p][p]Reaching the end of Dream World will give you a new achievement. Be on the lookout for additional achievements soon.[/p][p][/p][p]In the future, there will be more levels added to Dream World, so look forward to more![/p][p][/p][h1]Squeak mode enabled[/h1][p][/p][p]Ratty can now squeak [b]on demand[/b] with Left Mouse Button or Right Trigger. Has science gone too far??[/p][p][/p][h1]Other Fixes[/h1][p][/p][p]The secret cheeses UI text is now hidden by default, and you can click expand to show which levels you have found cheese in. [/p][p][/p][p]Audio and sensitivity sliders will now display correct positions when re-opening the menu.[/p][p][/p][p]---[/p][p][/p][p]This is the biggest patch yet, size-wise, so please report any bugs or glitches you come across in the bug topic here on steam. Thank you![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.11
notes.content:
Hello Rattys!
An update is now available for Rat Climber, if you do not see it, please restart your steam client.

[h1]Zone Length Timers[/h1]
The Individual Levels UI will now also display the segment length for each zone (in yellow text) in addition to the standard overall split time (in blue)

Ex: If you beat zone one in [i]10 seconds[/i], then you beat zone two in [i]30 seconds[/i], your (blue) split time on zone two will be 30 seconds since that is the [i]overall time[/i] since you began your run, 
and your (yellow) segment length for zone two will be 20 seconds since that is [i]only the time you spent in that specific zone[/i]. 

This is useful if you want to submit a video to a speedrun website for individual level, but the video contains multiple zones. These new timers save the user/moderator from having to manually subtract times.

[i]NOTE: The game uses centiseconds to calculate all times but it is not perfect so there will be cases where you might manually calculate your zone time and it is off by 1 or 2 centiseconds; this is expected. The game uses custom timer code in unreal that is affected ever so slightly by each individual user's framerate, code execution speed, and very tiny rounding stuff. If the game ever gets popular enough to where a few centiseconds are the difference between records, we will consider moving to external timing software, but for now, I think it is fine.[/i]

[h1]Cheese Tracking[/h1]
On the options menu, it will now keep track of which zones you have found cheese in or not.

[h1]1st Person FOV Increase[/h1]
In 1st person mode (T on keyboard / R3 on controllers (the right thumbstick pushed in button), the field of view has been increased to help you rat around better!

[h1]1440p Resolution[/h1]
There is now an option to set your resolution to 2560 x 1440 in the graphics menu. It will be buggy on 1920 monitors so use with caution if you are experimenting. Please report if this new resolution works correctly or not on people who have this size monitor (I do not so I am hoping it looks good)

[h1]Other[/h1]
All of the stairs in Egypt are now rat-sized! The Egyptians simply really loved their rodents

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
- Cheese counter will no longer go past 7/7 if your secret cheeses somehow respawns in your world and you collect them again.
- Pressing escape while viewing the customization menu will now properly close it.
- The sparkles on/off buttons should now work properly.

notes.title: Quick Hotfix July 10th
notes.content: Small bugfix! Don't worry about it!!

notes.title: Update 1.10
notes.content:
Hello Rattys!
An update is now available for Rat Climber, if you do not see it, please restart your steam client.

[h1]Customize Ratty's Appearance[/h1]
You will find new customization and appearance options in the color choose menu such as options to turn your fur on/off, make your fur shiny or normal, make yourself glowing and emit faint light, and leave a trail of sparkles as you travel! 

You can also now access this Ratty appearance menu at any time by clicking the new button in the options menu.

[h1]First Person Mode[/h1]
If you want to see the world from a new point of view, simply press T on keyboards or R3 (the right thumbstick pushed in button) on controllers to swap between 3rd and 1st rat-view

[h1]More Path Polishing[/h1]
As usual, I have added a small handful of new Planks-of-Destiny (tm) to the game to help you in your climb. 

You can find them:

- in the middle of Seaside Village above the wooden arrow area

- in the Swamp near the hanging cages section

- near the Egypt cheese location to help you safely recover

- in the lowest spot in Mystic Towers for any unfortunate soul who might have ventured down there looking for the outdated old cheese spot (I'm sorry!) You will now be able to climb back up to the main level from there.

notes.title: Update 1.09
notes.content:
Hello Rattys!
An update is now available for Rat Climber, if you do not see it, please restart your steam client.

[h1]New Rat Colors[/h1]
You can now make Ratty purple, green, blue, or golden!

[h1]Cheese Heaven Improvements[/h1]
You can now eat as much cheese as you want once you reach cheese heaven. Feast away ratty, you will never run out!
The invisible walls are now removed as well, if you wish to skydive after reaching the end of the game.

[h1]Path Polishing[/h1]
Another round of small fixes to make the pathing just a little bit smoother. You will find tiny tweaks to the windmill, a higher floor inside the minecarts (you no longer need to jump onto the metal bricks), more ground near the first cage trio in Swamp to save from a common fall that would send ratty to the very start of game, a few new planks in Egypt, and a quicker "rock garden" in Mystic Towers (just after the second set of floating wagon wheels)

[h1]Mystic Tower Cheese moved[/h1]
The secret cheese in Mystic Towers has been moved from its original spot that required you to sacrifice progress to acquire it, then you had to jump off the plank back to Egypt; it is now somewhere near the central tower!

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
Fixed a UI issue when the player hasn't unlocked the superjump yet and accessed the speedrun menu.
Fixed an issue where the timer wouldn't begin counting if you moved left or backwards upon restarting

notes.title: Hotfix June 10th
notes.content:
This is a quick hotfix patch that addresses two bugs:

- Users should now be able to unlock the "Skydiving Ratty" achievement now. It has also been changed so you only need to fall for 5 seconds instead of 10

- Fixed a bug that would sometimes make the safety walk get stuck and persist after letting go of the key

notes.title: Update 1.08
notes.content:
Hello Rattys!
An update is now available for Rat Climber, if you do not see it, please restart your steam client.

[h1]More speedrunning options[/h1]
- You can now choose a specific zone to restart in each time, instead of the first zone. This feature is only unlocked once you beat the game for the first time and get the "Climbing Rat" achievement.
- Superjump can be toggled on or off, as using it during a speedrun invalidates the run so this will prevent you from accidentally using it.
- Removed restart warning text to give you a faster restart. 

[h1]Improved path[/h1]
- Another round of path polishing (mostly in the first zone) to remove small frustrating obstacles that overly-slow down the momentum of gameplay, fixing of various graphical things, and addition of more "guide planks" like usual to make progression less confusing in spots.
- I have also added a recovery path to the right of the windmill if you happen to fall down there, and also a recovery path if you fell from the Crystal Mines down onto the northern house at the very start of the game

[h1]New shortcuts[/h1]
- New, shortcuts have been added or polished to every zone except mystic towers and shadow castle (these may also get changes in the future). Only the most observant and smart rattys will find these new shortcuts, they are not easily seen!

[h1]Crystal Mines fixes[/h1]
- The third minecart can be summoned at its initial starting spot if you somehow fell down and the cart is stuck in the vertical top spot, just go back to where it starts and press left mouse button/right trigger to reset it.
- A new safety zone has been added underneath the first major crystal jumping section that felt a little too unfair for failure this early in the game; Falling would send you straight back to the house near the start of Seaside Village. Now you have a very big chance of landing on the safety platform and can try again.

[h1]New swamp pond[/h1]
- I have completely reworked the small section near the Cypress Swamp pond area; the singular tree with spiralling wooden fences felt too slow and tedious when doing a run. This new pond area might get further tweaking in the future.

notes.title: June 4 Hotfix
notes.content: Quick fix to a UI issue

notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.content:
Hello Rattys!
An update is now available for Rat Climber, if you do not see it, please restart your steam client.

[h1]Speedrun features are now added into the game![/h1]
- In options menu, click "speedrun" button and you can toggle on/off the overall timer, and automatic time splits for when you reach each new zone
- The overall timer will remain at zero until ratty moves
- Individual level split times are automatically recorded upon transitioning to each new zone (the spots where the ambience track and lighting changes)
- The overall timer and final zone will end their timer once you reach cheese heaven and lose control over Ratty
- All timers will reset upon choosing restart from menu

[h1]Improved restart[/h1]
- Ratty will now always spawn at the exact same spot after restarting, facing the exact same way, and with the camera reset.
- Restarting will reset the three minecarts in Crystal Mines back to their starting spots. (entering the Crystal Mines zone will also do this automatically as well) 
- The "choose your Ratty's color" and welcome popup message now only appear once per play session instead of every time you restart

[h1]More options[/h1]
- You can now invert X and/or Y controls in the sensitivity menu
- Cleaner sensitivity sliders with only two decimal places instead of three, and easier number stepping

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
- Minecarts must now be activated with Left Mouse Button or Right Trigger on controllers once you are standing inside of them. This includes the 3rd vertical cart as well, it is no longer auto-traveling constantly
- This also fixes the old bug where minecarts would start going backwards sometimes upon jumping out
- Removed the camera zooming out after falling for a few seconds. There will be no more janky camera distance popping!
- I added a few more helper planks to some overly frustrating spots in the Swamp and Egypt zones
- There is also a little easter egg hidden in the Swamp zone, but not overly hidden. It's just a fun little nod to my current game project Knight and Fairy

Thank you all for the continued support. Happy climbing!

notes.title: May 15 hotfix
notes.content: Fixed a spot in Mystic Towers that could potentially softlock the player

notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.content:
Hello Rattys! 
An update is now available for Rat Climber, if you do not see it, please restart your steam client. 

- Ratty's cardio has improved! (The stamina meter mechanic is now removed, you can now dash freely)

- You can now hold dash while standing still to instantly begin dashing once you move, [i]you no longer need[/i] to already be moving to activate dash

- Default dash key is now left shift, and default safety walk key is now left ctrl

- You will now have a height-traveled meter in the upper right that shows your current height from the starting spot as well as your record highest meters achieved.

- Another small round of helpful props, boards, and pieces have been added to every zone in a few places to help make the path forward clearer and to help alleviate a few overly frustrating or awkward sections.

- There are a few more places where "recover strat" paths have been added so you are not forced to jump down to the previous zone if you find yourself on certain isolated platforms or ledges. Yes this also includes the evil, notorious vertical slits in the last zone!

As a side note, I don't think the levels will be changing much from now on or being altered. I think the zones are in a very good state at this point and I want them to be solidified and stable for speedrunners (as well as any guides or walkthrus that might be created) without them changing paths and strats constantly 

P.S. if any of you are serious about speedrunning the game, I highly suggest grabbing all of the secret cheese pieces, you will most definitely need the unlock from this!

Thank you all so much for your support and for those who spend their time to play my game on youtube/twitch, it means so much and I hope we can make the game grow together!

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.content:
Hello Rattys!

A small patch is now live for Rat Climber. It contains the following changes:

- Achievements! There are now ten achievements for you to unlock.

- Cleaned up confusion spots! I watched every single video and stream of my game since launch and I have fixed all of the spots that caused players confusion by adding a few various props and pieces to help navigation.

- Fixed a few frustration spots! Similar to above, I have also addressed a few places that felt "unfair" or caused a lot of failed jumps; or I have added very light safety pieces to give you a chance to recover. This was only in a very select few places because I don't want to make the game hand-holdey and easy, I still want to preserve the challenge and spirit of the game. 
[i]
Example: After you circle around the back of the house in Crystal Caverns and get up on the wooden platform, you must jump across small planks. In the old game, falling meant a drop straight down to the bottom of the first zone, but now I have added a few small platforms underneath that you can land on if you play it safe.[/i]

- Secret cheeses that you have found are permanently found and won't reappear between sessions. Although your location and zone reached won't be saved upon quitting, you will keep all your achievements, found cheeses, keybind and options, and the secret unlock for finding all 7 cheeses.

- The game will now launch in 1920x1080. The old version launched in 1280x720 and caused many streamers with overlays headaches.

- Fixed framerate has been removed and a smoothed framerate (tries to stay between 25fps and 144fps) is now implemented instead. This should remove the issue some players had where the game performed as if it was underwater in slow motion. 

As a note, the game still starts at medium graphical settings, so please feel free to increase draw distance and foliage if you don't like the pop-in that occurs!

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.content:
This small patch will now make Rat Climber launch with the following graphics configuration:

1280x720
Full screen
Medium settings for all graphical settings (shadows, texture quality, draw distance, foliage)

This is to ensure all players are able to launch the game and hopefully mitigate "out of memory" issues. If you want to increase the graphical settings and change resolutions, please press Escape/Enter on keyboard or start on controller to open the menu once in-game and adjust your settings to your liking.

Thank you, Rattys!

If you find any more bugs, please report them in the official bug report topic, you can go to the game's store page then click on "community hub" to find it

notes.title: Rat Climber is now available!
notes.content:
Hello, Rattys! 

The Rat Climber full game is now available to play as of Aug. 6th, 2024!

Here are some tips to help you in your journey to the top of the world: 

- jump against a wall and *mostly* face the wall but slightly towards the direction you want to be traveling will help you control precise jumps across small bricks. 

- jump without dashing, then hold dash while airborne to get a small distance boost which helps with precise gaps that are slightly larger.

- If you ever get stuck on how to progress, try to fit into small holes or look for tiny ledges and boards on sides of structures, you can walk on these! 

- It also sometimes helps to look ABOVE you and see what the path looks like ahead, and then work backwards to figure out your next spot to investigate.

- Find all seven secret cheese pieces (one per zone) and you will unlock something magical and fun...

- The game is designed to not have a save system, so if you quit, only your settings will be saved, not your progress!

Good luck climbing, Rattys!

notes.title: Demo Update 1.02
notes.content:
Hello, Rattys!

Update 1.02 Patch Notes

[list]
[*]Ratty will now travel less horizontally on his own when you are airborne. This should give an overall better sense of control and precision, especially when walking off of objects.
[*]The Demo will now let you choose your Rat's color at the start.
[*]The menu now includes full graphics setting options, ability to keybind your dash and walk to custom keys, sensitivity sliders, ambience and rat squeak volume sliders, restart, and quit buttons.
[*]Various performance optimizations.
[*]Various spots where objects would block the player camera and causing a jarring effect (such as walking through very tight areas with wood beams or having stone bricks directly above Ratty), have now been adjusted to ensure a smoother experience.
[*]Various ropes and rope fences on the sides of buildings have been removed to ensure a smoother experience.
[/list]

Thank you for playing and I hope you look forward to the full release!
